name: Generic FANUC 0i-MC vertical mill (4 axes, A along X)
model: VMC with FANUC 0i-MC and A-axis rotary table
description: Generic vertical machining centre with a FANUC Series 0i-MC control and a fourth rotary axis A whose centreline is parallel to X (rotary table on the machine table). Travels, rapids, spindle, tool changer and the rotary centreline height are typical values; replace them with the machine's parameters.
sources: Typical 4-axis VMC: X 762 / Y 410 / Z 510 mm travels, 24 m/min rapids, 8000 rpm BT40 spindle, 24-tool arm changer, A rotary table 7200 deg/min (placeholders)
axisNote: Placeholders: replace with parameters 1320/1321 (stroke limits), 1420 (rapid rates) and the rotary table centreline (mrzp).

mrzp.label: A-axis centreline
mrzp.source: Placeholder: the A rotary centreline 120 mm above the table centre; undefined work offsets are placed on it.

rotaryConvention.note: A turns the workpiece about +X following the ISO primed-axis convention (sense -1): a positive A command turns the table so that the tool moves positively about +X relative to the part. Flip the sense if a test move shows the opposite direction.

workOffsets.note: Work offsets that the program or the initial macro variables do not define (#5221+, #7001+) are placed on the A-axis centreline with A0.

parameterNotes.1401#1: LRP = 0: non-linear rapids, the FANUC default.
parameterNotes.3401#0: DPI = 0: values without a decimal point are least input increments, the FANUC default.

kinematics.description: X/Y/Z move the spindle relative to the table (drawn on the spindle side); the A rotary table turns the workpiece about a line parallel to X through the A-axis centreline.
